# Bench methodology — paired discipline runs

Arms are paired per task and seed; the scorer is deterministic (no LLM judge where a property check suffices). Cost factors cite real token counts from the run ledger, never estimates. A lift claim names the family, the host, the N, and the p-value; family-scoped pass means exactly that and no more.
